name: Commander Allocate-Timeout Hotfix
goal: Make the workspace CLI timeout configurable (default 900s) so a cold roleplaying-agents allocate is never killed mid-materialization, then relaunch Commander and confirm the first worker spawn completes.

tasks.name: Configurable workspace CLI timeout
tasks.description: H1-H3. config.py DEFAULTS add "workspace_cli_timeout_seconds": 900 directly after "max_swap_used_gb": 8.0,; orchestrator_mcp.py:505 WorkspaceClient(workspace_plugin_root, ssh_manager=ssh_manager, timeout=int(self._config.get("workspace_cli_timeout_seconds", 900))). Tests: test_config.py test_workspace_cli_timeout_default_is_900; test_orchestrator_mcp.py test_workspace_client_timeout_comes_from_config and test_workspace_client_timeout_falls_back_to_900, each monkeypatching ironclaude.orchestrator_mcp.WorkspaceClient with its own MagicMock ctor (overrides autouse default_workspace_client), constructing OrchestratorTools(registry, mock_tmux, ssh_manager=None, config=...), then ctor.assert_called_once() and ctor.call_args.kwargs["timeout"] == 777 / == 900 (config {}). Exact code: human plan Task 1.

tasks.name: Relaunch Commander and confirm first spawn
tasks.description: H4. No tests required: operational relaunch; evidence recorded in the log. Relaunch detached with Claude Code env unset; verify daemon+Brain up; await (ScheduleWakeup/Monitor, no tight polling) Brain's own d1501 spawn. PASS: new roleplaying-agents assignment reaches active; allocate duration from daemon/brain log timestamps bracketing the spawn call/result, else created_at->updated_at labelled as proxy (reserve->active incl. bind/reconcile). FAIL stop+report: any TimeoutExpired / 'timed out after N seconds' for any N (record N: 60 = change not live; 900 = exceeds budget). H4 NOT MET report reason: any other spawn failure; never claim pass. Always: no row left 'reserved' after the attempt, else stop and report. Record that remote SSH allocates do not use this timeout (workspace_client.py:217). Exact steps: human plan Task 2.
